name: Pantsir-S1
protection: Lightly armoured cab on some versions. Unarmoured. Game rule still treats the vehicle body as immune to small-calibre, but 7.62x54R and up penetrate; occupants, glass and tyres are exposed to all fire. Its 30 mm guns can engage ground targets (game proposal).
visual_notes: Truck-mounted (UAE: MAN SX 8x8; Russia: KamAZ 8x8) combat module at the rear
Turret with two missile banks of six tubes either side and twin 30 mm guns
Rotating search radar on top and tracking radar dish on the front
